newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls with crude, crack narrows a touc.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls with crude, crack narrows a touc.

text.p: NWE naphtha lost ground on Friday reflecting continued crude losses and good supplies.
"There are quiet a few cargoes because high crack values have encouraged refiners to produce naphtha," said one trader.
The spread between naphtha and crude has narrowed over the last week to stand around $62 a tonne having hit $70, but is still considered high. The spread is usually between $30 to $50 a tonne.
Crude's 70 cent drop over the last couple of days has been followed by sharp drops in naphtha.
One buyer was said to be looking for full-range cargoes around $205 cif NWE for February or under $200 for March with buyers holding out around $214.
